name: Swept Kick
author: Lyle Mills
description: 909-style kick: a waveshaped VCO swept down by its own pitch envelope, under a separate click-and-noise attack.

controls.label: Attack
controls.description: Mixes the click and noise burst over the body. Off at zero; the noise grows in after the click.

controls.label: Tune
controls.description: Sets the pitch sweep, from a short drop of under an octave to a longer boom falling from five times the note.

controls.label: Decay
controls.description: Sets the body's decay from a 60 ms thump to a two-second tail.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Noon is the waveshaped triangle VCO; counter-clockwise cleans it to a sine, clockwise drives it.

outputs.main: Mono: the complete kick. Stereo: left channel, with the body centred and its own attack noise.
outputs.aux: Mono: the click and noise attack alone. Stereo: right channel, with independent attack noise.

trigger: Strikes the kick and restarts its VCO and pitch sweep. Unpatched, the VCO drones at the note with Decay as its level.
